applicability: The on-demand full-body read of one task document (read_task_document_body, served by the dashboard's /api/task-document route) under one coordination root's tasks/ tree.
conditions: The requested path resolves to a file inside tasks/ whose payload carries the task-document schema.
Only the sprint execution-graph view consumes master documents, and it looks them up solely by the refs its graph nodes carry.
exclusions: The always-on summary and series projections (read_task_documents, read_series_documents) and the closeout-queue reader, which still enumerate the canonical corpus.
Lifecycle binding from the supplied enclosure list, which is not a task-corpus read.
Browser-side or other concurrent request costs (the eager review catalogue, notes/list).
statement: Reading one task-document body touches only the requested document and the master documents its sprint execution graph names; a document without an execution graph reads no master and lists no directory, so the cost does not grow with unrelated tasks.
